text: Every home kitchen hears the same question, every single night.
What's for dinner?
In our kitchen, the answer started as a list that was curated over years of scouring recipes online, flipping through cookbooks, and saving family favorites.
Every recipe worth making twice, cooked for the family, and tweaked until it was right.
Pad Thai. Bolognese. Chicken Shawarma. French Onion Soup.
The list kept growing...and growing...and growing.
But a static list can't tell you what you should cook tonight. Sometimes you need inspiration. Sometimes you need to know what you can make with what you have.
And if you have something special you want to cook, you need to easily know what you're missing.
So our list got an upgrade. A whole website of its own.
One part food. One part humor. All of it built for feeding the family.
This is Down With Hunger.
Every dish is here. Cuisines from around the world, everything from breads to entrees to desserts.
Browse the whole collection, filter by cuisine, see every vegan option, browse holiday menus, or get inspired and spin the globe.
Got chicken thighs to use up? Search the ingredient and see every dish that stars it.
Behind the scenes, the staples are already accounted for.
Spices, sauces, rice, noodles, and the proteins that are always available. More than two hundred and fifty items, loaded in ahead of time.
So the site already knows what's on hand.
Making a meal on the fly? Open, What can I make?
Add anything extra you've got. Say, a can of pineapple juice.
Teriyaki Chicken just made the cut. Everything you can cook right now goes to the top, and the near misses tell you exactly what they're missing.
Just visiting? No account needed. Type in what you have, and it works the same way.
Planning a quick shopping trip for one dish? Open the recipe, and flip, Can I cook this?
What you have turns green. What you need turns red.
Shopping list: done.
And when nobody can decide, hit Surprise me, and let the reel pick dinner.
Every dish worth cooking, one click away.
Down with hunger.
